summary: Add a tenant-scoped supplier and procurement workbench around the existing PurchaseOrder and WMS boundaries.

impacts.evidence: All procurement repository reads and writes require authenticated organization/workspace scope, set PostgreSQL tenant settings and use forced RLS evidence tables.
Price-list bytes are read only from released uploads; raw files, credentials, provider payloads and unnecessary personal data are excluded from ordinary records, events and responses.
Supplier, offer, price-list, purchase-order, receiving and reconciliation operations are additive OpenAPI paths with generated SDK artifacts.
Writes use existing canonical event envelopes and transactional outbox; PO transitions, receiving and price import have versioned event types and append-only evidence.
No provider-specific connector capability is admitted; connector and plugin SDK boundaries remain unchanged and external procurement writes stay deferred.
Expand-only migration 45 adds supplier/offer/PO columns, scoped keys and append-only history, preview, PO event, receiving and reconciliation tables with catalog checksum and backup requirement.
ReleasedObjectRef digest verification, tenant scope, input bounds, default-deny procurement permissions and omission of raw credentials protect the import and operator boundary.
Approval-bound PO approve/send requires a matching approved request for the same PO; recommendation-derived drafts verify the immutable replenishment snapshot digest.
Supplier, price-list, PO and receiving mutations write sanitized audit records, and PO/price evidence retains actor, correlation, versions and timestamps.
Tenant-scoped idempotency covers draft PO and operator actions, receipt facts are replay-safe, and unknown send outcomes become explicit findings rather than blind success.
This epic makes no external provider call or inbound webhook; connector/EDO/marketplace egress remains a separate qualification boundary.
Queries, upload parsing, rows and evidence are bounded; normalized statuses, unknown send state and reconciliation findings provide operator visibility.
Migration 45 is expand-only and high risk with backup requirement; rollback is capability disablement and worker drain, without destructive down migration.
Domain, CSV/XLSX parser, API route, OpenAPI parity, SDK generation, migration, architecture, frontend and Docker qualification checks cover the admitted boundary.
